name: Scripted tools
description: Tools written as scripts: the weather now from Open-Meteo, a digest of the host's notes, and a request echoed back.

secrets.name: apiKey
secrets.label: Any text: the echo tool sends it as a key

tools.name: current_weather
tools.description: The weather now at a place given by its latitude and longitude: temperature in °C, wind in km/h and the WMO weather code.

tools.name: notes_digest
tools.description: How many notes the user keeps in this app, and the latest three.

tools.name: echo_request
tools.description: Sends a note to an echo service with the package's key and says what the service saw, and which requests the host refused.
